source_signatures.text: Mama said that during the summer vacation, she took a course to help boost the result of the exam and won a large sum of money.
source_signatures.source: 妈妈说暑假考研做助诱拿了大几千完了

source_signatures.text: You paid with this exam to your mom a lot of gold coins?
source_signatures.source: 你凭着这个考研跟你妈妈报了多少钱金币了呀

source_signatures.text: Seven thousand five thousand is a large number.
source_signatures.source: 七千五千又是大几千

source_signatures.text: Your mother is thinking about the house.
source_signatures.source: 你妈妈在家里心想着

source_signatures.text: My son is studying for a graduate exam at school.
source_signatures.source: 我儿子在学校里面要考研

source_signatures.text: Your mother is dancing with the lobster older woman in the square dance.
source_signatures.source: 你妈妈跟龙虾大妈跳广场舞

source_signatures.text: Or when the daughter is quiet, the son will be more.
source_signatures.source: 或者说女儿闷的时候人家会比较儿子

source_signatures.text: Now how is it that your mother is proud to tell the people
source_signatures.source: 现在怎么样你妈妈很骄傲地跟人家说

source_signatures.text: My son
source_signatures.source: 我儿子

source_signatures.text: Now preparing for the graduate entrance exam.
source_signatures.source: 现在准备考研准备弄个考个研究生

source_signatures.text: You speak slowly, and your heart still feels a little bit happy that your son is there.
source_signatures.source: 你慢慢一边说一边内心还有点开心自己儿子

source_signatures.text: I am working.
source_signatures.source: 想上进但是呢你在干嘛

source_signatures.text: You are gambling and you are asking me to borrow a loan.
source_signatures.source: 你在赌博你要借我网贷

source_signatures.text: You are in a web dating situation where everyone is using this to borrow money.
source_signatures.source: 你在网恋你们老的都是通过这个博去引钱去掉

source_signatures.text: No one has anything to brag about.
source_signatures.source: 一线就没东西装逼

source_signatures.text: That is you.
source_signatures.source: 这个就是你

source_signatures.text: Repay the loan
source_signatures.source: 充值战备还贷款

source_signatures.text: Soon, the land will be returned to the original owner.
source_signatures.source: 过几天又年本代地的输回去

source_signatures.text: This is the classic process of scamming or borrowing money.
source_signatures.source: 这个是经典的流程是什么呢骗钱或者借钱

source_signatures.text: Then recharge.
source_signatures.source: 然后去充值

source_signatures.text: Just the subsidy plan may win for a while.
source_signatures.source: 只是补贴计划可能赢一段时间

source_signatures.text: It will come down to one day when the top and the top will not be able to lose everything.
source_signatures.source: 就会有一天上头上头完全不全部输完

source_signatures.text: After that, they start borrowing money or deceiving it.
source_signatures.source: 之后又开始借钱或者骗钱

source_signatures.text: And then he entered again and then the subsidy plan.
source_signatures.source: 然后又冲进去然后又补贴计划

source_signatures.text: Then maybe they will win or lose it all, but the result is the end result.
source_signatures.source: 然后可能又赢或者说直接输反正最后的结果

source_signatures.text: It will definitely lose, for this is the loop.
source_signatures.source: 一定是输反正就是这个循环

source_signatures.text: This is reading dogs.
source_signatures.source: 一直来一直来这个就是读狗的

source_signatures.text: No escape from the loop; no single dog can escape.
source_signatures.source: 循环逃不掉的没有一个独狗能逃掉

source_signatures.text: For example, to enroll in a political class or a small class, you need to pay 10000 yuan.
source_signatures.source: 比如说要上政治小生小课生班什么的又要到了一万块

source_signatures.text: Okay because you're holding on to your learning
source_signatures.source: 完了因为报精辟你就拿着你让学习

source_signatures.text: To run a research project, a political student must have a class.
source_signatures.source: 要跑研究要政治小朋友身班什么

source_signatures.text: You are going to deceive your mother with money.
source_signatures.source: 东西的你从通通往到这种事情去骗你妈妈钱

source_signatures.text: Do you read this and find out if it's a lie?
source_signatures.source: 你看看读这个真的什么谎都杀得出来

source_signatures.text: You can't tell a lie with money.
source_signatures.source: 一段为了骗钱什么话都杀得出来

source_signatures.text: As long as you can get money.
source_signatures.source: 只要能骗到钱就行

source_signatures.text: He ignores whoever is facing him and ignores himself.
source_signatures.source: 他不管对面是谁不管自己

source_signatures.text: To earn money, to get money, to recover
source_signatures.source: 在做了什么事情只要能要到钱只要能翻本

source_signatures.text: Qian wins back all the lies.
source_signatures.source: 钱赢回来所有的谎话

source_signatures.text: can not be treated as a threat
source_signatures.source: 就可以不当等伤害

source_signatures.text: At this point, the mother has become increasingly doubtful.
source_signatures.source: 这个时候妈妈已经有点不相信了

source_signatures.text: Mother still doubted me because of me.
source_signatures.source: 妈妈还是怀疑了但是由于我
